'''Blue Three''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the third member of [[Blue Squadron]]. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadrons with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Blue Three.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Blue Three was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] [[Slammer/Legends|Slammer]], who flew a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] and was killed in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]].<ref name="SR" />

Blue Three was the call sign of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] "[[Rookie One]]" when he flew with [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="RA" />

The call sign was also used by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE pilot]] whose [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]] was shot down in the [[subjugation of Jabiim]].<ref name="E:TWSotW" />

During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|evacuation of Hoth]], Rebel Alliance pilot [[Will Scotian/Legends|Will Scotian]] flew as Blue Three.<ref name="I146">{{InsiderCite|146|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch}}</ref>

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pilot with the call sign Blue Three was a member of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Edor Crespin]]'s [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] [[Blue Squadron (New Republic)|squadron]] stationed at [[Folor Base]] . During the [[Battle of Folor|base's evacuation]], "Blue Three" was separated from a squadronmate using the call sign [[Blue Four/Legends|Blue Four]], who mistakenly believed that "Blue Three" had been killed in battle.<ref name="XWWS" />

Blue Three was the call sign of New Republic pilot [[Alexandra Winger]] prior to her capture by the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Judicator/Legends|''Judicator'']]<ref name="SoG">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/shadesofgray/index.html|text="Shades of Gray"|int=Shades of Gray|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref> in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="TERC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blue Three is the call sign given to [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]]<ref name="ANHn">''[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]''</ref> and [[Star Wars (1977) 6|comic adaptation]]<ref name="SW6">[[Star Wars (1977) 6|''Star Wars'' (1977) 6]]</ref> of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']]. However, in the final film, he is identified as [[Red Three/Legends|Red Three]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
